unknown_capability.meaning: Manifest lists a capability outside the known set

missing_deeptutor_func.meaning: cognisphereTutor entrypoint is missing a required function

missing_top_level.meaning: Export bundle missing a required top-level key

missing_safety.meaning: Export bundle safety object missing a required key

unexpected_source_of_truth.meaning: safety.source_of_truth is not an allowed Cognisphere value

forbidden_full_official_statements_inclu.meaning: Bundle includes full official problem statements

lc003_ontology_missing.meaning: Export depends on missing ontology artifacts

entrypoint_import_failed.meaning: Failed to import plugin entrypoint module

export_failed.meaning: Plugin export_deeptutor_package failed or returned ok=false

benchmark_unavailable.handling: Skip or stub until plugin P5 surfaces land
